head: 5b29e768000b97450163258ece84f2c611c484ac
claim: The stuck-worker matcher names a question dialog on real pi and codex panes and a provider quota wall on a real OpenCode pane

steps.start: three real runtimes launched in a private tmux server
steps: pi is told to ask a question and opens its dialog
codex is put in Plan mode and opens its question dialog
opencode shows its question dialog or its provider quota banner
each pane is read by jg_stuck_verdict
steps.result: the stuck-worker matcher names the question or quota cause for each real runtime

verdicts.seen: I read three entries plus a PASS line. pi: verdict shows the question dialog hint 'Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · n to add notes'. codex: Plan mode question dialog, verdict 'tab to add notes | enter to submit answer'. opencode: quota wall, verdict 'Free usage exceeded, subscribe to Go [retrying in 2h 15m attempt #1]'. All three match the outcome's named parts, and nothing contradicts them.
